items.criterion: PROOF: merged origin/main tests classify empty/empty as actionable keyless duplicate and preserve genuine public-key mismatch; FAILIF: empty/empty is reported as different public key.
items.detail: Merged: fix commit 812a3333 ("fix: address DF-CRIER-504") is an ancestor of origin/main (40386adc) — `git merge-base --is-ancestor 812a3333 origin/main` => "812a3333 IS ancestor of origin/main". Classification: internal/registry/store.go:504-511 registrationConflict returns ErrAgentExists with "keyless registration for %q already exists; use a different id or delete the existing agent" when both keys are empty, and ErrPublicKeyMismatch only when registrationKeyDiffers (store.go:492-497) observes different bytes. Tests: internal/registry/registration_conflict_test.go:17 `{name: "empty-vs-empty", wantKeyless: true}` (wantMismatch false) and :39-41 assert the error contains "keyless" and does NOT contain "different public key"; :18-19 (empty-vs-set, set-vs-different-set) assert wantMismatch:true and :29-33 assert the mismatch class does not also match ErrAgentExists. MCP surface: internal/mcp/registration_conflict_test.go:22-28 asserts the actionable message and rejects "different public key"; internal/mcp/server.go:551-557 now returns the wrapped msg for ErrAgentExists. Fresh runs: `go test -short -count=1 -run TestRegistrationConflict_KeyCombinations -v ./internal/registry/` => PASS all 4 subtests, `ok github.com/crier-dev/crier/internal/registry 0.006s`; `go test -short -count=1 -run TestRegisterAgent_KeylessDuplicateSurfacesActionableMessage -v ./internal/mcp/` => `--- PASS ... ok 0.006s`; `go test -short -count=1 ./internal/registry/... ./internal/mcp/...` => `ok .../internal/registry 8.004s` / `ok .../internal/mcp 6.798s` (exit 0). LSP diagnostics: 0 findings.

items.criterion: Genuine public-key mismatch is still classified as ErrPublicKeyMismatch (not collapsed into the keyless duplicate) across the shared classifier and the HTTP 409 body.
items.detail: internal/registry/store.go:505-507 returns ErrPublicKeyMismatch when registrationKeyDiffers; internal/registry/handler.go:818-834 emits 409 with error=public_key_mismatch plus the immutable/unchanged/DELETE remedy; internal/registry/reregistration_test.go:63-83 (assertStructuredKeyConflict) pins the wire literal, the message contents and the remedy. Run: `go test -short -count=1 -run TestReRegistration -v ./internal/registry/` => PASS for all 11 tests including TestReRegistration_KeylessOverKeyedIsAConflict, TestReRegistration_StoreReportsTheConflictClass, TestReRegistration_RemoteStoreDistinguishesTheConflict, TestReRegistration_LegacyRelayIsNotMisreported (`ok ... 0.019s`).

items.criterion: The keyless-duplicate classification is reachable from the real registration entrypoints (memory/sqlite/postgres stores and the MCP register_agent tool), not only from the unit-level helper.
items.detail: All backends route through the shared classifier: internal/registry/memory_store.go:20 `return registrationConflict(existing, agent)`; internal/registry/sqlite_store.go:158 `return registrationConflict(old, a)`; internal/registry/postgres_store.go:295 `return s.registrationConflict(ctx, agent.ID, pubKeyArg)` which delegates to the shared rule at postgres_store.go:319-324. MCP entrypoint: internal/mcp/tools.go:33-52 builds an Agent with empty HexKey when keyless is allowed and calls s.store.Register; the error reaches the client via mcpError (internal/mcp/server.go:551-557). End-to-end tool test internal/mcp/registration_conflict_test.go:10-29 passes (`ok .../internal/mcp 0.006s`).

items.criterion: The actionable keyless message survives the transport seam: the HTTP 409 body and the RemoteStore/MCP decoders do not re-report empty/empty as a public-key mismatch.
items.detail: Verified with a throwaway probe (written, run, then deleted — `git status --short` shows only .gitreins/tasks.yaml modified) driving the real handler + RemoteStore (newRemoteTestServer, signing off): duplicate keyless register => err `agent already registered: agent already registered: keyless registration for "kl" already exists; use a different id or delete the existing agent` (errors.Is ErrAgentExists true, ErrPublicKeyMismatch false, no "different public key" wording); keyed-over-keyless => `agent already registered with a different public key: agent "kl" is already registered with a different public_key; a registered key is immutable ... DELETE /agents/kl` (ErrPublicKeyMismatch). Probe result: `--- PASS ... ok 0.006s`. Decoder path: internal/registry/remote.go:392-408 only maps CodePublicKeyMismatch to the mismatch class and everything else to ErrAgentExists. Note (not a failure): no committed test covers this HTTP/RemoteStore keyless-duplicate seam — coverage is the unit-level registrationConflict test plus the MCP tool test.
